knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to say you will check and confirm the answer in writing by a stated time. Guessing (option 0) and ignoring the question (option 2) both break the communication standard.

A complaint is recorded with the facts, the customer's words, the date and who it was passed to. Recording nothing unless written (option 0) and keeping only the name (option 2) leave the complaint untraceable.
The lesson says to confirm each booking in writing, with the date, time window, address, scope and any access arrangement.

practicalCriteria: Learner confirms a booking in writing with date, time window, address, scope and access arrangement.
Learner records a supplied phone complaint with the facts, the customer's words, the date and the designated contact it was passed to.
Learner tells the customer who will respond to a complaint and when, and does not offer a refund or remedy without authority.
Learner updates a supplied customer record with a dated entry after a change, in the approved system.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Booking confirmation, change notice and reminder records
Complaint record with facts, response and outcome notified to the customer
stopWorkCriteria: Learner agrees a refund or remedy without authority
Learner keeps customer records outside the approved system
